data.title: 水原千鹤 · 阳台暮色下的脱序心跳
data.action: 单手拢起刚洗过的乌黑长发，修长指尖拿着发夹，转头望向隔壁阳台，红着脸收起营业微笑，眼神真挚动人。
data.location: 公寓相连的晾衣阳台，夕阳将晾晒的白衬衫染上橙金暖晕
data.timeOfDay: 黄昏收衣服的私密时刻
data.lighting: 东京黄昏壮丽的夕阳残照，在发丝与微透真丝边缘镀上一圈金红色轮廓光
data.mood: 卸下完美女友面具后的真实羞涩，日常邻家感与心动交织
data.description: 公寓相连的晾衣阳台，夕阳将晾晒的白衬衫染上橙金暖晕。单手拢起刚洗过的乌黑长发，修长指尖拿着发夹，转头望向隔壁阳台，红着脸收起营业微笑，眼神真挚动人。 她微微抬眸轻语——“别看我平时在约会里穿得光鲜亮丽……这才是私底下一文不值的我。你……还愿意看吗？”
data.promptProse: Standing on her apartment balcony at dusk beside fluttering laundry on the line, Chizuru Mizuhara lifts her damp brown hair with a hairclip in a terracotta-orange silk slip dress with fine bust pleats and beige lace trim. Turning toward the neighboring balcony with an authentic, deeply blushing smile, she is rimmed in golden Tokyo sunset light.
data.animaCaption: Standing on her apartment laundry balcony gathering damp hair with a clip in a pleated terracotta silk slip dress, she turns toward the neighboring rail with an unguarded blush and flushed ear. Golden sunset backlighting rims her nape and the hanging white shirts.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an understated terracotta-orange silk slip dress with fine accordion pleats across the bust, beige lace trim, and delicate spaghetti straps.
